title: Microsoft Corporation Form 10-K (synthetic)
text: Intelligent Cloud revenue grew 22% with Azure and other cloud services up 29%. Capital expenditure intensity rose: capex was 18% of revenue versus 14% a year earlier, driven by AI-optimized data-center build. OpenAI is not consolidated on the 10-K; the relationship is disclosed as a strategic partnership and investment, not a controlled subsidiary. Copilot appears as a Microsoft 365 and Azure consumption attach, not as a separately consolidated OpenAI line. Management warned that capex can stay elevated while Azure growth remains the primary payback.
